> -- OPERATOR GROUPING ------------------------------------ <repl>

(<) is declared `infix 4`, which does not associate, so I cannot tell
how `a < b < c` should group. Add parentheses to say what you mean.

1| 1 < 2 < 3
         ^
> -- RESERVED OPERATOR ------------------------------------ <repl>

(&&) is short-circuiting syntax elaborated to an `if`, not a
call, so there is no (&&) value to name.

1| (&&)
    ^^
> -- RESERVED OPERATOR ------------------------------------ <repl>

(&&) is short-circuiting syntax elaborated to an `if`, not a
call, so there is no (&&) value to name.

1| infixl 3 (&&)
             ^^
> -- FIXITY DECLARATION ----------------------------------- <repl>

After `infixl` I expect a precedence level from 0 through 9,
then the operator, like `infixl 6 (+)`.

1| infixl 12 (<?>)
          ^^
